symptom: A script reimplements PNG decoding, DXT compression, mip scaling, or DFF parsing
check: Search the JSR API, then npm, before writing a helper
fix: Use @cross/image, dxtn, and rw-parser-ng from deno.json

pattern: New npm package will not load
symptom: Loading unprepared module for a package that deno add just installed
fix: Set nodeModulesDir to auto and gitignore node_modules

pattern: Sheet bounds read from a scaled preview
symptom: The viewer shows 2000 px for a 2400 px sheet, so estimates drift by the scale
check: Run slice-sheet edges on a thin window beside each border
fix: Write the measured cuts into the manifest

symptom: One pixel under alpha 255 makes the texture DXT3, which doubles its size and breaks a stock header comparison
fix: Fill alpha to 255 in test fixtures, and expect DXT3 only for real transparency

symptom: dxtn throws when a side is not a multiple of 4, which the 2x2 and 1x1 levels are
fix: Pad to 4x4 with a nearest resize before compressing

symptom: gta3.dir holds chef.dff twice and a map keeps only one
check: parseDirectory returns a list for each name
fix: Update every entry that shares the name

symptom: img.ts and extract-skins.ts each parse gta3.dir
fix: Export one reader and import it in both scripts

pattern: Probe files left in the repo
symptom: skins/_probe and skins/test show in git status
check: git status after a test run
fix: Move probes to the scratchpad folder before finishing

symptom: outfits.txd held textures named after outfits and no .dff asked for those names, so install:skins skipped it
check: dffTextureNames of the mesh against txdTextureNames of the archive
fix: Build one slot per outfit with import-skin --base, so the mesh and the texture name match

symptom: player.txd installs and the default outfit does not change
check: models/generic/player.bmp exists in the game folder
